messages:
Aisha (Support): FYI we have a P1 from NovaRetail - their pilot classification precision dropped ~18% since yesterday's model swap. Customer flagged false positives on returns detection. Ticket NR-3312.
DeployBot: NR-3312 marked P1 and routed to customer-success.
Ravi (CSM): Renewal conversation scheduled in 3 weeks. This trend will definitely trigger a risk signal. We need a clear short-term mitigation and plan to communicate.
Lina (CS Ops): Can you paste a few examples of bad outputs and the model id they hit? I can draft an exec note and rollback comms.
Aisha (Support): Attaching examples (redacted): 
- input: "customer requests refund for damaged item" -> label: "no_refund" (was "refund" previously)
- input: "item arrived late, wants replacement" -> label: "no_action"
Model id in logs: rwd-model-v3-beta-2026-04-01. Baseline was rwd-model-v2-stable.
Derek (SE): Looks like a scoring threshold change + new tokenization tweak in v3. We can temporarily route NovaRetail to v2-stable variant while we investigate. If they're on Dedicated that's just routing config; hosted customers we can add a per-tenant override. ETA for rollback ~30-60m.
Ravi (CSM): Please do rollback ASAP and then I will send a calm exec note saying we've reverted to the stable variant and are doing a targeted root-cause. Need a one-line impact for their C-suite.
Lina (CS Ops): Draft comms for ops and exec: 
"Hi <Name>,
We detected a regression in model variant rwd-model-v3-beta that affected classification precision for your pilot. We've reverted your tenant to rwd-model-v2-stable to restore expected behavior. Our engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up with findings and a timeline within 24 hours.
— NovaRetail support"
Helena (Product): We'll need the diffs in training data + feature flags used between v2 and v3. Also capture any prompt/template changes from NovaRetail. I'll join root-cause.
Derek (SE): Rolling back routing now for tenant id nr_889. Applying canary rollback then full. Monitor window 15m.
DeployBot: Routing change deployed to canary for nr_889 by Derek.
Aisha (Support): NovaRetail ops confirmed they see predictions back to expected levels in dashboard.
Lina (CS Ops): Action plan + owners: - Immediate rollback & monitoring -> Derek (done) - Customer ack + exec note -> Ravi (within 1h) - Root-cause triage (model diffs, tokenization, thresholds) -> Helena + Derek (24h) - Postmortem + renewal impact note -> Lina + Ravi (48h) - Capture user feedback + update enablement doc -> Ravi (postmortem)
Ravi (CSM): Adding a quick enablement session with their ML ops team to review how to test model swaps safely; propose a staged canary gate for future model variants.
Aisha (Support): Ticket NR-3312 updated and handoff to CS after rollback confirmed.
Derek (SE): If root cause is just threshold change, we can push a minor patch to v3 and run an A/B with lower risk. I'll include suggested threshold delta in triage.
Helena (Product): Also flag product ticket for "per-tenant model variant guardrails" and "preflight check for classification delta". This will reduce recurrence.
Lina (CS Ops): I'll prepare the renewal risk note template with metrics: precision delta, user impact, mitigation steps, and timeline. Ravi, will you sign off before we send to execs?
Ravi (CSM): Yes — will sign off. Thanks team. Marking as handoff complete once postmortem draft is ready. :thumbsup:
